info.title: Kayko EBM API
info.description: Official Kayko EBM third-party API gateway for Rwanda Revenue Authority (RRA) EBM 2.1. Authenticate with a business API key. Routes cover initialize, customers, constants, codes, items, sales, purchases, stock, and imports.

ApiKeyBearer.description: Kayko business API key from Settings → Enable EBM → Generate API key. Example: Bearer sk_live_…

ApiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyHeader.description: Alternative to Authorization Bearer. Pass the raw sk_live_… / sk_test_… secret.

InternalToken.name: X-API-Token
InternalToken.description: Internal EBM_INTERNAL_API_TOKEN for /initialize/* (not a business sk_ key).

item_code.description: Optional on create. Omit to let Kayko allocate the next code for this origin/type/units prefix. If sent, the first 7 characters must match those fields.

item_type.description: Product type label or legacy code: raw_material / 1, finished_product / 2, service / 3.

packaging_unit.description: Packaging unit code (for example NT). See GET /constants/packaging.

quantity_unit.description: Quantity unit code (for example U). See GET /constants/quantity.

tax_type.description: Tax category. Prefer B for standard VAT goods. F is VAT on fuel. Do not send TT.

use_tourism_tax.description: When true, the item is tourism-taxable (upstream useTTaxYn).

sequence.description: Line number 1–999. Optional on some write APIs; auto-numbered in array order when omitted.

item_classification_code.description: Ten-digit classification; required on purchases/stock, optional on sales.

post.description:
Submit a normal fiscal sale for signing.

Use this when a customer pays for goods or services and you need a legally signed EBM receipt. Returns print fields (`receipt_signature`, `internal_data`, counters, SDC, MRC, `tourism`). Stock-out is queued after VSDC `000`, not in this HTTP response.

**Prerequisites:** register each `item_code` first; seed `POST /stocks/master` for stocked goods; send `purchase_code` when `customer.tin_no` is present (business buyer). Sync fuel products with `POST /items/fuel/sync` before selling fuel.

**Gotchas:** do not set `original_invoice_no` equal to `invoice_no` on normal sales; `tax_type` F is VAT on fuel (18%), not tourism; do not send `tax_type` TT (use `use_tourism_tax`); fuel invoices require `sale_purpose` and `rrp`.

Response codes: `000` success; `881` missing purchase code; `910` parameter/tax rates/totals; `994` duplicate. Kayko errors use `{ status, message, date, ebm }`. `ebm.resultMsg` is the unmodified VSDC text.

parameters.description: Taxpayer Identification Number, exactly 9 characters for this business.

parameters.name: x-branch-id
parameters.description: Two-character branch office ID. Any allowed branch may sell; head office is `00`.

invoice_no.description: Your sequential CIS invoice number. Must be unique for new sales.

payment_method.description: How the customer paid. Labels map to VSDC payment codes (see GET /constants/payment-modes).

purchase_code.description: Required for business customers (when customer.tin_no is set). Max 6 characters. Missing → VSDC 881.

customer.description: Nested buyer identity. Prefer this object; do not send flat customer_tin at the root.

tin_no.description: Buyer TIN (9 characters). Validate with GET /customers when unsure.

telephone.description: Buyer phone. Kayko normalizes digits for VSDC.

origin_date.description: Sale date YYYYMMDD. Defaults to today when omitted.

buyer_accepted.description: Whether the buyer accepted the invoice. Defaults to accepted when omitted.

receipt.description: Optional receipt print template fields (header/footer, trade name, etc.).

items.description: Invoice lines. Each item_code must already be registered.

packaging_unit.description: Packaging unit code (for example NT). See GET /constants/packaging.

quantity_unit.description: Quantity unit code (for example U). See GET /constants/quantity.

tax_type.description: Tax category. B is standard 18% VAT. F is VAT on fuel. Do not send TT; use use_tourism_tax for tourism.

item_classification_code.description: Optional 10-digit classification; filled from catalog when omitted.

use_tourism_tax.description: When true, this line is tourism-taxable (ttAmt computed). Prefer registering the item with use_tourism_tax.

rrp.description: Regulated retailer price. Required on fuel lines (or taken from catalog default_price).

regulated_discount.description: Fuel only. Maps to prftDcAmt. Normal discounts are rejected on fuel lines.

sale_purpose.description: Required when the invoice includes fuel items. Maps to salePurposeCd 01/02.
